svg.text: ROAD / DASH — CITY AROUND THE RACE AVENUE
Primary avenue first • balanced city on both sides • straight-edged blocks / buildings
RED: common race avenue GOLD: Old Market branch CYAN: Station Avenue branch
Dark: streets • grey: sidewalks • tan: footprints • green: courts • pale access lanes lead to towers
Draft spine: 0–3.15 km farms / transition; 3.15–12 km city. Height/detail maps are in the atlas.
